title: How it works: sensors in the field
talking_points: Small solar-powered sensors sit in the ground at chosen points in each field.
Each sensor reports soil moisture, temperature, and salinity on a set interval.
One sensor cluster typically covers a few acres, depending on soil variation.

content.headline: Sensors report from the ground, not just the sky
